name: medical-appointments
description: Systeme de gestion des rendez-vous medicaux - monorepo backend NestJS + frontend React

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/backend install --no-bin-links && npm --prefix apps/frontend install --no-bin-links
scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/backend run build && npm --prefix apps/frontend run build
scripts.db:up: docker run -d --name medical-db -e POSTGRES_USER=postgres -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres -e POSTGRES_DB=medical_appointments -p 5432:5432 postgres:16-alpine
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/backend run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/frontend run typecheck
